system.description: Innumerable stars and constellations swirl inside a dark orb that seems to be absorbing the surrounding light like a black hole. And yet, the longer you lose yourself staring into the blackness, the more things become clear... Celestial Order wizard spends the better part of an evening staring into the Crystal Ball, he can add a number of tracking tokens to this card equal to his character rank. Anytime thereafter, the wizard can choose to remove one tracking token from this card in order to replace a {Dm} for or for a {Dc} in any dice pool.
